name: Customize Deployment
description: Interactive guided deployment flow for Azure OpenAI models with full customization: model version, SKU (GlobalStandard/Standard/ProvisionedManaged), capacity, RAI policy, and advanced options.

promptPatterns: \b(custom(ize|ized)? deploy|choose (version|sku)|set capacity|configure content filter|RAI policy|PTU deployment|provisioned throughput)\b

commands.injectPrompt: Apply the customize skill: run an interactive guided deployment — step-by-step selection of model version, SKU, capacity, content filter (RAI policy), and advanced options (dynamic quota, priority processing, spillover).
